about_the_game:
Widlands Dominion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a team of warriors through deadly, monster-infested lands. Each hero has a distinct class and skillset, and as they survive battles, you’ll upgrade their stats and choose from a set of perks to shape their roles in combat.

Fights unfold on a grid-based battlefield filled with unpredictable tile effects—adding a layer of danger and opportunity to every move. Adapt your strategy, position your units carefully, and guide your team through deadly encounters. The fate of the Widlands depends on your command.

Key Features

  • Build your warrior band by recruiting heroes from distinct classes, each with their own unique skills and combat roles.

  • Level up your heroes through battle, upgrade their stats, and choose from a wide range of powerful perks to shape your strategy.

  • Permadeath. All warriors who fall in battle stay dead every fight carries real consequences.

  • Chart your path through the Widlands in a roguelike structure with branching routes, randomized encounters, and increasing danger.

  • Battle across dynamic environments where certain tiles trigger traps, curses, forced movement, or other effects that can shift the tide of combat.

  • Face a diverse enemy roster, each with unique equipment, abilities, and perks that challenge your tactical thinking.

  • Encounter different final bosses at the end of each run each presenting a unique threat and requiring a different approach.

  • Spend earned reputation and gold points between runs to unlock stronger warriors and expand your options for future expeditions.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game revolves around killing enemies on grid-based battlefields. This results in a mild gore such as blood splatters or blood pools, but gore certainly isn't focus of the game.

Build a team of warriors, each with unique classes and skills, and venture into treacherous dungeons. Adapt your strategy, overcome deadly foes, and put an end to the dark force threatening Widlands.
